subject.title: feat: optional info lines (IP, uptime, OS, location) on the name tag

question: Should Nameplate support opt-in persistent IP, uptime, OS-version, and fleet-location lines on the name tag, shipping the user-facing implementation on macOS first?
rationale: The patch is technically correct and proven, but expanding the identity overlay to persistent network/location facts and selecting a staged platform rollout require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the full feature
options.body: Accept all four default-off fields on macOS and treat equivalent Windows and Linux behavior as later parity work.

options.title: Start with lower-sensitivity fields
options.body: Land uptime and OS version while deferring IP address and fleet location.

options.title: Keep details menu-only
options.body: Decline persistent info lines and retain the existing on-demand system-information presentation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the full feature
recommendation.body: Accept all four default-off fields on macOS and treat equivalent Windows and Linux behavior as later parity work.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and currently owns the central overlay, system-info, settings, and fleet-identity behavior involved in this choice.
